description: PHP engine functions reimplemented in crates/support/php-std, checked against the real functions. There is no PHP library to cover: every operation calls a built-in.

bound.preg_match: One pcre2_jit_match() call on the same PCRE2 10.44 JIT code in both runtimes; what surrounds it (the compiled-pattern cache lookup, the shared match data, the three captured strings and the $matches array) is the work PHP does too

compat.unserialize: PHP's serialize() format, read only where PHP wrote the value (PHP-shared cache entries, Memcached's serialized values); no Rust hot path decodes it, as Rust's own caches use the native codec
compat.igbinary_unserialize: PHP's igbinary format, kept for entries shared with PHP; Rust's own caches use the native codec
